name: Amazon SCK4 Inbound Cross-Dock Stockton CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Multi-lane controlled gate ~150m up the entrance drive from the public frontage road: guard island with STOP pavement markings on both inbound and outbound lanes, yellow hatched safety striping (37.9086,-121.1888).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Staffed booth structure(s) on a raised concrete center island splitting in/out lanes, ~1-2 car footprint with canopy - visible at z21.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trucks/trailers staged along the public frontage road shoulder (seen in Street View) and a deep paved approach drive before the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron inside the gate before the dock/yard rows.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entrance drive runs ~150m from the public road across a vacant buffer to the gate, then into a wide apron - holds well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single guarded gate complex handles both in and out via paired lanes split by the guard island.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approx 2 inbound lanes at the guard island; counted from overhead striping, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Approx 2 outbound lanes on the other side of the guard island.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with extra paved width and queue stalls - room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock with dock doors and trailers backed in along both the north and south long building faces; well over 50 doors total (estimate ~200).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of trailers parked without tractors in the large west drop yard plus north/east rows - far over 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Classic IXD cross-dock: doors on opposite (north and south) building faces serve receiving vs. outbound to FCs.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Stockton industrial park surrounded by farmland and vacant land to the east; judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated large trailer-storage drop yard west of the building, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest linear corridors are roads.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: dockDoorCount, trailersVisible and trailerParkingCapacity are overhead estimates - the trailer rows are dense and partly cut off at frame edges; treat as approximate.
